market_summary: During the London/New York overlap, all five assets are consolidating within their session Volume Profile Value Areas and hovering near fair-value POCs or testing structural boundaries on sub-2.0 RVOL. While metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD) exhibit structural weakness below downward-sloping VWAPs and EMA50 baselines, both are extended into their lower ATR bands and Session Low supports without yellow volume confirmation, creating elevated risk of bear traps. FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) and BTCUSD remain stuck in mid-channel compression around their baselines. A disciplined HOLD is maintained across the entire portfolio until genuine expansion volume confirms directional continuation.

Given the ATR stretch, lack of volume surge, and immediate structural support, shorting into support is poor risk-reward. HOLD.
